title: SEBI SCORES 2.0 Online Grievance Redressal System
source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
content: SEBI Complaints Redress System (SCORES 2.0) is a centralized online platform allowing investors to lodge grievances against listed companies, stock brokers, depository participants, mutual funds, or SEBI-registered intermediaries. Entities are mandated to resolve lodged complaints within 21 calendar days. Unresolved complaints are automatically reviewed by designated Monitoring Bodies or escalated to Online Dispute Resolution (ODR).
